fixer.title: sessions: Preserve default chat identity in partial summary updates

introducer.title: sessions: Show catalog chats in the session list

cases.mechanism: Each partial catalog/status notification could replace the default chat with a peer and each detailed-state update replace it back, causing repeated active-chat fallback and synchronous layout/panel reconciliation on message and tool-confirmation status transitions.
cases.symptom: Visible Agents-window layout blinking and redundant synchronous layout work during repeated session status updates.
cases.fixedBehavior: The changed handler merges the cached backend default-chat URI into partial catalog notifications before reconciliation, so metadata/state updates retain the same main-chat object and no longer trigger active-chat fallback or downstream layout reconciliation. Explicitly supplied defaults still override the cached URI.
cases.evidence: The base handler passed partial `changes` directly to `chatMetadataFromSummary`; when `defaultChat` was omitted, an opaque advertised default failed `isDefaultChatUri`, was recreated as a peer, and removed the stable main chat from `session.chats`. `VisibleSessions` then synchronously fell back because its active chat was absent (visibleSessions.ts:985-995). Alternating detailed-state and summary updates reversed this identity on each update. The added regression test drives three status cycles and asserts a single active-chat publication, while layout consumers synchronously observe active-chat changes: ChatLayoutContext increments layout generations (chatLayout.ts:84-94), panel visibility/view synchronization reruns (baseSessionLayoutController.ts:360-421), and the desktop strategy reapplies session composition in multi-session mode (desktopExistingSessionStrategy.ts:141-174).
